section: Fixes and new things
pr: 1297, 1298, 1301, 1302, 1303, 1304, 1305, 1306, 1307
roadmap: Editor sign-in and frozen-input fixes, hang watchdog, faster editor (Visual Script panel, thumbnails), new loading screen, Versions page with test builds, asset streaming round 1
---
- The editor signs in again on Windows and opens your project. Before,
  it could not reach the OkaySpace server at all.
- The editor no longer ignores every click after an unclean exit: the
  recovery questions now show one at a time in the middle of the screen.
- Quit in the editor's sign-in window works.
- If the editor ever stops responding, it now writes okay_hang.txt and
  offers Wait or Close after a few seconds, so you no longer need Task
  Manager.
- Opening a project and the Problems list are much faster: the project
  files are read in the background.
- The Visual Script panel is three to six times faster on big graphs,
  Project panel pictures no longer stall the editor, and update checks
  run in the background.
- Big worlds load around the player in the background, a little each
  frame, instead of all at once (asset streaming, first part).
- The editor's loading screen shows real progress, what is loading, the
  project name and the version.
- The launcher sees a closed editor as closed, even after Task Manager.
- Versions page: install the newest three releases and, with Get test
  builds on, the newest three test builds. It also shows when the editor
  was left on another version and offers Repair.
- Test-build updates now follow the main build only, in order.
- Game invites keep their id on Windows, Run in browser sends whole
  files, and Move With Keys reacts only to the keys you chose.
